items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 17, 2022 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I played with Sun Ra with Charles Tolliver too and we played other gigs.

ctx.x: And back in New York Charles Tolliver and his partner started Strata East in 1971. Is that a coincidence or was it the atmosphere and relationship —

That was a coin — now it’s really ironic because I played with Sun Ra with Charles Tolliver too and we played other gigs. I played other gigs with Charles and myself with like Olatunji, like the conga player from Nigeria, we played dances and stuff. We was young so we was playing all kinds of gigs, dance gigs we were playing all kinds of social parties for West Africans and you know we were playing Latin stuff. Then we played bebop as well. But Charles is six months older than me. He was born in March, I’m born…
